name: koci-new-char
author: syfqpie
description: Configure what a new character gets on first login: spawn map, Zeny and starter items.

settings.label: Spawn map
settings.description: Map name new characters are warped to on first login (e.g. prontera). Leave empty to keep the default spawn.

settings.label: Spawn X
settings.description: X coordinate on the spawn map. 0 picks a random spot.

settings.label: Spawn Y
settings.description: Y coordinate on the spawn map. 0 picks a random spot.

settings.label: Starting Zeny
settings.description: Zeny given to a new character on first login.

settings.label: Starter items
settings.description: Items given on first login as id:amount pairs separated by commas, e.g. 501:50,601:10.

settings.label: Only characters at base level 1
settings.description: Skip characters above base level 1, so existing characters do not get the starter pack when the mod is first enabled.
